args.body: If FR-BOAMP-PUBLIC-DOCS-LINK-QA remains unfinished, use the raw response and director-record-shape.json if committed. If there is none, save and read back the bounded result and close under valid ownership with a lesson. Distinguish missing scope fields, unapplied or unverified filtering, and a reviewed original notice that excludes a fit. No external submission.
